issue.title: rafthttp: leader spoofing via X-PeerURLs

repository.name: etcd
repository.description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system

issue.body:
The fix for #3699 lets a peer accept transports from unknown peers that set the `X-PeerURLs` header. While this avoids the deadlocking new leader problem, the upshot is a "bad" peer with an arbitrary URL may announce to a recovering node that it owns the leader's id. The recovering node would then accept raft messages from the spoofed leader.

This could be problematic for a possible auto-TLS design where each server would have a cert in the raft log. A node would only talk to a server if its cert matches the one found in the raft log. To get around the new leader problem, a recovering node could request the current cluster status from a known node. If the node is too far behind, it can bootstrap from a given a known good peer URL.
